messages:
Alex K: Thinking about saved queries in Console analytics — quick design q: should saved queries be scoped to route/model or org-wide? e.g., 'Per-route view: /v1/generate' vs 'Model: redwood-1-quant-8' — pros/cons?
Maya R: I'd prefer model-scoped by default, with option to pin route filters. Most customers think in terms of model performance across routes.
Samir: agree but platform teams want route-level for billing + SLOs. We need both.
Jae (product): Proposal: savedQuery has scope: [org|team|route|model], and attachments for filter set + pinned columns. Default scope = team. Thoughts?
Alex K: sounds good. How do we handle naming collisions and sharing? e.g., 'P99 latency - redwood-1' used by multiple teams.
Maya R: Add owner and visibility flag (private, team, org). For collisions, show owner and team in UI and append '(copy)' on create.
Samir: Also need versioning for queries so changes don't break saved dashboards. Could store query as immutable snapshot + mutable alias.
Jae (product): +1. UI notes: we should have quick actions: 'Apply to route', 'Duplicate for model', 'Make public'. Also keyboard shortcut to save current filters as saved query.
Alex K: API surface: POST /saved-queries {name, scope, visibility, filters, pinned_columns}. Draft schema:
```
{ "name": "string", "scope": "model|route|team|org", "visibility": "private|team|org", "filters": [{"field":"route","op":"=","value":"/v1/generate"}], "pinned_columns":["p99","cost"] }
```
Samir: Need RBAC check on create/update; org-wide requires org-admin.
Maya R: Telemetry: tag saved-query usage to know which presets are most used. We should track apply_count, last_used_at.
Telemetry Bot: saved_query.used event emitted on apply (scope, id, user).
Alex K: UI/UX decision: default landing for route page = 'My team's saved queries' + 'Suggested' (auto-generated: high-latency routes).
Jae (product): follow-up: how do we de-duplicate suggested queries vs saved? maybe show 'Auto-suggested — can save' badge.
Samir: Edge case: when model is changed (version rollover), saved query referencing model should show stale warning and offer 'rebind to latest'.
Maya R: + add audit log for save/edit/delete.
Alex K: ok I'll sketch schema + API and hand to eng docs. Anyone want to take the API PR?
Samir: I'll pick it up.
Maya R: I'll do the UX mocks.
Jae (product): thanks — please drop PR links here and we'll iterate. :thumbsup:
